content: Pip dialogue follows pressure-state: short/practical in danger; clipped/quiet when hurt; suddenly specific and talkative in breakthrough moments.
Pip's only thought at Rolzen breaking the impossible is "that's what it looks like"; he does not understand why he is crying again.
First thing once clear: Pip hugs Daisy May and Majiskii, smiles big, then becomes unusually talkative and asks Rolzen everything.
First line is Rolzen: "So you must be Majiskii!" Rolzen blushes from surprise; Pip is the one who briefly forgot where he was.
Dogs choose the only correct route; hesitation/explore/loot/save attempts in the prison cost lives.
Requires immediate blast on hinge-open, correct crowd-clear sequence, evade timing, Rolzen jump-cue response, wall-climb/gust/crystal-ball final jump/path summon.
Former gymnast daredevil performer; lost partner to wraith-aging; defended New York by luring zombie Mack away until finally overwhelmed and taken.
Only Rylos knows why manifestations intensify after Vaedric's altar breach; tells Xethrolund years into Pip search.
